title: Samuel Beveridge in Topsham, 1752
status: Historical name-and-location lead, NOT a deed
summary: Wheeler's 1878 history reproduces an early Topsham map key with marker 3 labeled Samuel Beveridge; its Appendix I also lists Samuel in 1752 with locality/lot 3. These references are useful settlement clues but no original lot conveyance or family relationship has been verified.
source_title: Wheeler, History of Brunswick, Topsham and Harpswell (1878), printed pp. 40–41 and Appendix I pp. 870–872
next_record: Locate the underlying 1752 map and property entry in Pejepscot Proprietors Coll. 61; identify exact original manuscript leaf, image, term of possession and any deed; then distinguish marker number from deeded acreage.
person_status: Not linked to any existing family profile

title: James Beveridge listed at Topsham, 1758
status: Named settler or land-owner candidate; original deed not inspected
summary: The 1878 Wheeler town-history appendix, reproduced by Genealogy Trails, includes James Beveridge, year 1758, locality 'Lot 7'. The list encompasses settlers OR landowners and does not by itself prove a fee-simple deed or identify James with the 1724 Marblehead child or 1749 Georgetown intention.
source_title: Wheeler, History ... (1878), Appendix I, Topsham settlers / landowners list
next_record: Find original proprietor account or conveyance for lot 7, 1758, and verify witnesses, residency, grantor, grantee, neighboring boundaries and chain of title.
person_status: Unverified; do not assign to James Jr. family-tree ID

title: Robert Beveridge named in 1776 local military roster
status: Massachusetts state-archive compilation confirms dated service, promotions; underlying original muster not inspected
summary: The Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth's published archival compilation identifies Robert Beveridge of Topsham as a private who enlisted March 11, 1776, in Capt. William Lithgow's company; records promotion to corporal on March 22 and sergeant on August 9, 1776; then explicitly associates the same indexed service entry with later Ensign Robert in Capt. George White's company. The underlying pay/muster sheets remain to be inspected.
source_title: Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors of the Revolutionary War (1896+), archived compiled service entry 'Beveridge, Robert, Topsham' (B-surname section)
next_record: Retrieve the original Capt. William Lithgow payrolls for March–November 1776 and identify the archival roll identifiers; examine exact full name, residence and rank changes. Next seek contemporaneous birth, land and probate sources linking the Topsham officer to his household (none yet located).
person_status: State archival compilation ties his military entries, NOT his parents, birth, death or a link to James or Samuel.

title: Robert Beveridge listed as ensign, George White's 1777 company
status: Officer appointment in same Topsham Robert entry of Massachusetts archival compilation; original commission not inspected
summary: The same Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth service compilation lists Robert Beveridge of Topsham as Ensign in Capt. George White's company, Col. Ebenezer Francis's regiment; it references pay/subsistence from December 3, 1776 and says commissioned February 3, 1777. This explicitly associates the officer with the 1776 Lithgow service in the published compilation, without proving a particular family line.
source_title: Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors of the Revolutionary War (1896+), Robert Beveridge, Topsham archival entry
next_record: Locate original Massachusetts State Archives Francis-regiment commission and White-company return for Ensign Robert; compare with the 1904 handwritten copy of White's later 1778 muster, which does not automatically represent every officer who served during 1777.
person_status: Military continuity compiled from Massachusetts archives; relationship to early Beveridge settlers unknown.

title: James Beveridge and Jean White intention, 1748/9
kind: Printed transcription of contemporaneous town intention
summary: Brunswick intentions record James Beviridge/Beveridge and Jean Write/White of Georgetown under February 1748/9 (normalized 1749). Two published variants transcribe one underlying clerk's record, not two independently documented marriages.
next_record: Locate original intention ledger and a separate dated wedding/solemnization entry; prove identity and lineage independently of later descendants' compilation.
person_status: May or may not be the 1724 Marblehead James; not proven

title: 1760 Topsham manuscript map (geographic context)
status: Original map exists, family-specific parcel not identified
summary: Maine Historical Society catalogs a manuscript Topsham map dated 1760 within Pejepscot Proprietors Coll. 61, Map 33. This establishes an original geographic record exists, NOT that it depicts a specific Beveridge lot or usable modern coordinates.
source_title: Maine Historical Society, Pejepscot Proprietors papers Coll. 61, Map 33 (1760)
next_record: Inspect original map image/key at high resolution, compare 1752 marker 3 and 1758 lot 7 labels, cite original coordinates only if historically surveyed and independently georeferenced.

title: Robert Beveredge recorded as fifer at Georgetown, 1775
kind: Massachusetts state archive compilation; distinct surname variant
status: Archival compiled 1775 service; same identity as Topsham Robert UNPROVEN
summary: The published Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors compilation separately lists Robert Beveredge (variant spelling), fifer in Capt. James Lemont's seacoast company, enlisted July 22, 1775, with service through December 31, 1775 at Georgetown, Lincoln County. Geographical proximity does not establish this is the Topsham Robert named in 1776.
source_title: Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors of the Revolutionary War (1896+), 'Bevekedge, Robert' fifer variant in B section
next_record: Obtain original 1775 Capt. James Lemont company roll; compare signatures, birth/residence records and 1776 Lithgow personnel; note that the index uses multiple surname spellings.
person_status: Unverified separate identity; no tree relationship or automatic merger.

title: Robert Beverage listed aboard brig Tyrannicide, 1777
status: Named in archival compilation; identification with Topsham officer unproven
summary: A separate Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors entry lists Robert Beverage as a seaman on the brigantine Tyrannicide under Capt. Jonathan Haraden, engaged March 13 and discharged August 31, 1777. This potentially overlaps the land-service timeframe, so identical identity must NOT be presumed from surname spelling alone.
source_title: Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors of the Revolutionary War (1896+), 'Beverage, Robert' brigantine Tyrannicide entry
next_record: Locate original brigantine Tyrannicide crew/pay roll and compare Robert's town, age, signature and service overlap with the 1777 Topsham Ensign; keep distinct unless a contemporaneous identity bridge appears.
person_status: Namesake candidate; no family-tree linkage or proven equivalence.
